stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: When General Ross turns his tanks and guns on Bruce Banner at Culver University, his daughter Betty begs him to stop. He ignores her, and she watches Bruce die.
stages.whoA: Her father, the general who opens fire on Bruce
stages.whoB: His daughter, who begs him to call off the attack

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: After Tony's death, a U.S. general seizes Stark Industries and orders the Liberator drones into production. His military puts J.A.R.V.I.S. at the controls of the drone army sent into Wakanda, until the Wakandans cut the link.
stages.whoA: The general who takes command of his drone army
stages.whoB: Tony Stark's AI, running the drone army sent against Wakanda

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Maverick joins Wolverine's crew to bury Dr. Cornelius, the Weapon X scientist who made them killing machines. In the ruined Arctic lab, Cornelius greets them as stray dogs come home, then turns into a Brood creature.
stages.whoA: A Team X soldier who comes to his lab to end him
stages.whoB: The Weapon X scientist his team comes to bury

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: When Leech falls gravely ill on Christmas Eve, Ape helps steal an ambulance for its medicine. In the tunnels, Ape readies a place beside the boy for Wolverine's blood transfusion, and Leech pulls through.
stages.whoA: The sick Morlock boy he helps save at Christmas
stages.whoB: A Morlock who steals an ambulance to save him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Gladiator and Starbolt fight side by side in the Imperial Guard, first for D'Ken against the X-Men and the Starjammers. When Lilandra claims Jean Grey, they battle the X-Men again on the Moon over the Phoenix.
stages.whoA: A hot-tempered fellow guardsman in the Imperial Guard
stages.whoB: The Imperial Guard's leader, who fights beside him

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Gladiator and Starbolt fight together in the Imperial Guard as it overruns Ronan's Kree soldiers for Deathbird. Gladiator brings Ronan down at her feet.
stages.whoA: A hot-tempered fellow guardsman in the war with the Kree
stages.whoB: The Imperial Guard's leader, who fights beside him against the Kree

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Bella Donna's Assassins kidnap Bobby and the Thieves' tithe, and she lets him go only when Gambit agrees to marry her. At the tithe, her fake box nearly dooms the Thieves, and Bobby cries out for her destruction.
stages.whoA: Gambit's brother, a Thief she holds for ransom
stages.whoB: The Assassins' leader who kidnaps him

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Bobby and Bella Donna bicker over who called them home, until the risen Gambit reveals the invitations were his. He bends both their minds, and they fight the X-Men together for him.
stages.whoA: Gambit's brother, called home beside her by the risen Gambit
stages.whoB: Gambit's old flame, called home beside him by the risen Gambit

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Boomer frees the webbed-up Martian warrior Vulcan, and the two team up to rob a bank of its gold. Spider-Man turns Vulcan's own homing bolt back on him, sending him into space, then catches Boomer.
stages.whoA: The Martian warrior he frees to help rob gold
stages.whoB: The safecracker who frees him and robs a bank with him

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Señor Fuentiz and the crash survivors reach the Cloud City of Gold, where its conquistador ruler DeVargas has them captured. Spider-Man frees them, and they flee as DeVargas's cannon fire sets off the volcano.
stages.whoA: A stranded professor he takes captive
stages.whoB: The conquistador who holds him captive

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Cowboy and Ox work as a team for the Plotter, grabbing a series of blueprints while Spider-Man is knocked out. When they come back for the one they left behind, Spider-Man's photo lure lets him catch the gang.
stages.whoA: His partner in the Plotter's blueprint thefts
stages.whoB: His partner in the Plotter's blueprint thefts

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Baron Mordo conjures illusions of Peter's late parents, who greet him side by side and draw him into the cult. Doctor Strange breaks the spell, and the couple fades away.
stages.whoA: Her husband, Peter's late father
stages.whoB: His wife, Peter's late mother

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Years before, Richard and Mary pose as traitors in Russia to learn about the Red Skull's Doomsday device. When the KGB catches on, they leave their evidence with Dr. Groitzig, fearing they will not get home alive.
stages.whoA: Her husband and fellow American spy
stages.whoB: His wife and fellow American spy

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Robert follows the gang that robbed his mother's store and takes their jet tech for a rocket skateboard. Jackson Weele chases him in the Big Wheel to get it back, until Robert and Spider-Man send it into the water.
stages.whoA: A teen who steals his gang's jet tech
stages.whoB: The gang boss who chases him in the Big Wheel

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Robert tries to turn his life around for his ailing mother, but after her store is robbed he uses stolen tech to rob a jeweler. Mrs. Farrell collapses when she sees her son on TV, and Robert turns back to doing right.
stages.whoA: Her troubled teenage son
stages.whoB: His ailing mother, who runs a grocery store

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Gila and Monitor, lizards made smart by Connors' DNA, kidnap him with Gecko and call him their father. When Gila refuses to let Spider-Man be destroyed, she is chained up too, and both are turned back into lizards.
stages.whoA: A fellow lizard who helps kidnap Connors
stages.whoB: A fellow lizard who turns against the plan

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Thunderer and the Whizzer, old teammates in the Six American Warriors, fight side by side once more. With Spider-Man, they take on the Red Skull and Electro.
stages.whoA: A speedster teammate in the Six American Warriors
stages.whoB: A loud-voiced teammate in the Six American Warriors

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Omar, revealed as the Black Marvel, fights beside the Thunderer, who spent fifty years watching the doomsday site as a homeless man. The old teammates battle the Red Skull and Electro with Spider-Man.
stages.whoA: An old teammate who kept watch over the doomsday site
stages.whoB: The Black Marvel, an old teammate in the Six

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Keene Marlow puts on his Destroyer costume again and rejoins the Whizzer and the other Warriors. Together they take on the Red Skull and Electro at Spider-Man's side.
stages.whoA: A speedster comrade from the Six American Warriors
stages.whoB: The Destroyer, a comrade from the Six American Warriors

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Destroyer and the Black Marvel fight together again as the Six American Warriors reunite. With Spider-Man, Keene and Omar take on the Red Skull and Electro.
stages.whoA: The Black Marvel, his old comrade in arms
stages.whoB: The Destroyer, his old comrade in arms

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Kingpin makes Dr. Lopez the lab partner on Johnathon Ohnn's portal work, and he falls for her. As the Spot, he turns on the Kingpin to save her, and she follows him into the rift he seals.
stages.whoA: His lab partner, the woman he loves
stages.whoB: The portal scientist who falls in love with her
